newsitem.title: USA: Envoy seen as buyout target-Business Week.
newsitem.headline: Envoy seen as buyout target-Business Week.

text.p: Evnoy Corp is an attractive buyout target, Business Week magazine reported, citing an analyst at the New York-based investment firm First Albany.

Joel Krasner, an analyst at First Albany, told the magazine that Envoy's acquisition of Healthcare Data Interchange from Aetna U.S. Healthcare makes it "the leading pure-play" in the fast-growing electronic processing of health-care claims industry.
In a buyout, Envoy's shares are worth between $50 and $55 each, Krasner added.
The shares closed Thursday at 32, down 1/4.
A New York money manager, whose name the magazine did not disclose, said that HBO & Co, which supplies computer systems to healthcare firms, might be one company seeking to acquire Envoy.
Officials at HBO & Co were not immediately available to comment.
